## 1. Monotonic Pipeline Instrumentation (`R8`)

`ProcessTurnOutput` and the WebSocket `response_completed` payload expose raw `time.perf_counter()` stage timestamps in `stage_timestamps` alongside derived millisecond latencies:

| Timestamp Key | Recorded At |
|---|---|
| `speech_end` | Capture endpoint (`AudioCapture.last_capture_metrics.speech_end_mono`) for mic/PTT turns (`null` for uploaded WAVs or text turns). |
| `stt_start` | Immediately before invoking `WhisperTranscriber.transcribe(...)`. |
| `stt_completion` | Immediately after `WhisperTranscriber.transcribe(...)` returns. |
| `routing_completion` | Immediately after `HybridPlanner.plan(...)` returns. |
| `tool_completion` | Immediately after `ToolRegistry.execute_intent(...)` finishes (for deterministic/tool/clarify turns). |
| `llm_first_token` | On arrival of the first non-empty token from `OllamaClient.stream_conversation(...)`. |
| `first_valid_speech_chunk` | When the first language-validated text/sentence chunk is queued to TTS. |
| `tts_completion` | Monotonic timestamp when TTS synthesis of the last chunk completes (`PlaybackMetrics.tts_completed_mono`). |
| `first_non_silent_output_callback` | Recorded **inside** `_BoundedPcmBuffer.read_into_callback()` the first time `max(abs(out_mono)) > 1e-6`. |
| `playback_completion` | After ring-buffer drain + hardware PortAudio `stream.latency + 0.04s` settle delay (`PlaybackMetrics.playback_completed_mono`). |

### Derived Latency Fields (ms)

Anchored to `base_mono = speech_end` (when available) or turn start:
- `time_to_first_text_ms`: `base_mono -> first_text` (`llm_first_token` for conversation, `tool_completion` for tools, `routing_completion` for greetings/refusals).
- `time_to_first_synthesized_audio_ms` (`ttfa_ms`): `base_mono -> first_audio_ready_mono` (first TTS chunk ready).
- `time_to_first_audio_output_ms` (`audio_startup_ms`): `base_mono -> first_non_silent_output_callback`.
- `playback_duration_ms` (`playback_ms`): `first_non_silent_output_callback -> playback_completion`.
- `total_turn_duration_ms`: `base_mono -> turn_completion`.

> **Callback Timing vs. Physical Acoustic Arrival:** `first_non_silent_output_callback` measures the exact monotonic moment the first non-silent PCM samples are written into the PortAudio output callback buffer (tested here using a real-time simulated 48 kHz `OutputStream` callback thread with no physical speaker output). Physical acoustic arrival at a human ear adds OS WASAPI/MME buffer + DAC propagation latency (`~20–80 ms`) and must be verified subjectively during human acceptance testing.

## 2. Sequential Ollama Placement & Performance (`R7`)

Executed sequentially on `127.0.0.1:11434` (`think=false`, `num_predict=100`, `num_ctx=4096`), unloading each model (`keep_alive=0`) before loading the next, with `ollama ps`, `nvidia-smi`, and `psutil` snapshots:

| Model | `ollama ps` Processor | VRAM Used (Before -> Active / 6144 MiB) | System RAM Used (Before -> Active) | Cold EN (TTFT / 1st Sent / Total / tok/s) | Warm EN (TTFT / 1st Sent / Total / tok/s) | Warm HI (TTFT / 1st Sent / Total / tok/s) | Warm KN (TTFT / 1st Sent / Total / tok/s) | Script & Semantic Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`qwen3.5:4b` (default)** | **`100% GPU`** (`3.1 GB`) | `1111 -> 4944 MiB` (`94%` util) | `10375.6 -> 11264.0 MB` (`+888 MB`) | `5729.02 / 6241.25 / 6693.66 ms` (`40.40 tok/s`) | `257.36 / 844.60 / 1219.99 ms` (`41.55 tok/s`) | `295.83 / 1025.11 / 1439.85 ms` (`41.07 tok/s`) | `296.21 / 2592.68 / 2766.42 ms` (`40.48 tok/s`) | EN/HI/KN all pass `validate_response_language()`; accurate EN/HI; verbose/awkward KN phrasing but valid script. |
| `qwen3.5:9b` | `41%/59% CPU/GPU` (`6.2 GB`) | `1111 -> 5573 MiB` (`31%` util) | `9999.5 -> 13097.1 MB` (`+3098 MB`) | `10869.06 / 13312.94 / 15314.97 ms` (`9.67 tok/s`) | `373.90 / 2894.61 / 5232.88 ms` (`9.88 tok/s`) | `694.86 / 3632.04 / 7025.86 ms` (`9.95 tok/s`) | `686.58 / 7690.50 / 7793.85 ms` (`9.85 tok/s`) | Best KN prose, but spills 41% to RAM, ~4x slower (`7.69s` to 1st KN sentence), leaves only `571 MiB` VRAM headroom. |
| `nemotron-3-nano:4b` | `100% GPU` (`2.8 GB`) | `979 -> 3764 MiB` (`25%` util) | `10225.6 -> 10982.5 MB` (`+757 MB`) | `3935.89 / 4431.58 / 4452.49 ms` (`46.45 tok/s`) | `252.68 / 755.71 / 777.04 ms` (`47.62 tok/s`) | `343.98 / 520.36 / 541.57 ms` (`50.54 tok/s`) | `313.24 / 830.58 / 852.56 ms` (`48.24 tok/s`) | Fast EN, **fails HI/KN semantics** (`"है, आपका सवाल है।"` in HI; echoes KN question). |

**Decision:** Keep `qwen3.5:4b` as default (`100% GPU`, `~41 tok/s`, safe 6 GB VRAM co-existence with CUDA `faster-whisper-small`, `keep_alive="15m"`). Deterministic commands (greetings, identity, capabilities, clock, timers, smart-home) execute in `<20 ms` without touching Ollama.

**Observations:**
- Deterministic EN/HI/KN commands achieve **`37.80–459.14 ms`** to first audio output on text and **`340.03–364.79 ms`** on EN WAV -> EN/KN speech (well under the `~1–2s` target).
- Kannada voice input (`voice_wav_kn_timer`) takes `2620.09 ms` in STT because Whisper-small runs first for multilingual language detection before delegating to `indic-conformer-kn` (`2.66s` to first audio output).
- Warm English general conversation achieves **`905.42 ms`** to first audio output (under the `~2–3s` target); Kannada conversation takes **`3397.40 ms`** due to `vits-mms-kan` CPU synthesis (`2210.37 ms`) and longer Kannada token generation (`3055.50 ms`).
